Pr22.Imaging

Class RawImage

  • java.lang.Object
    • Pr22.Imaging.RawImage

  • public class RawImage
extends java.lang.Object
    Low level image data of the system that can be saved or converted to BufferedImage.

      • convert

        public RawImage convert(RawImage.PixelFormat format,
                        int xsize,
                        int ysize,
                        int sline)
                 throws General
        Converts the RawImage to a specific pixel format and size.
        Parameters:
        format - Pixel format of the target image. If this parameter is Undef, the format remains the same.
        xsize - Horizontal size of the target image in pixels. If this parameter is 0, the width remains the same.
        ysize - Vertical size of the target image in pixels. If this parameter is 0, the height remains the same.
        sline - Length of a row in bytes (x size * size of a pixel in bytes). If this parameter is 0, the system computes the correct value.
        Returns:
        The converted RawImage in the desired pixel format and size.
        Throws:
        General
